info.title: Q_Threshold_Entry
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

action.description: This parameter selects threshold cross behavior:  * `ecn` - Remark ECT packets to CE when the threshold is crossed

ecn_threshold_all.description: `all` threshold configuration:   * `start_point` - The threshold starting point percentage for all colors of traffic. Once the threshold is crossed, the associated `action` will be performed.

start_point.description: The threshold starting point for all colors of traffic.  Once the queue fills past the threshold value,  the associated `action` will always be performed.

non_responsive_green.description: The weighted random early detection configuration  for green-colored non-responsive traffic.

max_probability.description: The weighted random early detection maximum probability  for green-colored non-responsive traffic.

max_threshold.description: The weighted random early detection threshold maximum  point for green-colored non-responsive traffic.

min_threshold.description: The weighted random early detection threshold starting  point for green-colored non-responsive traffic.

non_responsive_red.description: The weighted random early detection configuration  for red-colored non-responsive traffic.

max_probability.description: The weighted random early detection maximum probability  for red-colored non-responsive traffic.

max_threshold.description: The weighted random early detection threshold maximum  point for red-colored non-responsive traffic.

min_threshold.description: The weighted random early detection threshold starting  point for red-colored non-responsive traffic.

non_responsive_yellow.description: The weighted random early detection configuration  for yellow-colored non-responsive traffic.

max_probability.description: The weighted random early detection maximum probability  for yellow-colored non-responsive traffic.

max_threshold.description: The weighted random early detection threshold maximum  point for yellow-colored non-responsive traffic.

min_threshold.description: The weighted random early detection threshold starting  point for yellow-colored non-responsive traffic.

random_detect_green.description: The random early detection configuration  for green-colored traffic.

max_probability.description: The random early detection maximum probability  for green-colored traffic.

max_threshold.description: The random early detection threshold maximum  point for green-colored traffic.

min_threshold.description: The random early detection threshold starting  point for green-colored traffic.

random_detect_red.description: The random early detection configuration  for red-colored traffic.

max_probability.description: The random early detection maximum probability  for red-colored traffic.

max_threshold.description: The random early detection threshold maximum  point for red-colored traffic.

min_threshold.description: The random early detection threshold starting  point for red-colored traffic.

random_detect_yellow.description: The random early detection configuration  for yellow-colored traffic.

max_probability.description: The random early detection maximum probability  for yellow-colored traffic.

max_threshold.description: The random early detection threshold maximum  point for yellow-colored traffic.

min_threshold.description: The random early detection threshold starting  point for yellow-colored traffic.

responsive_green.description: The weighted random early detection configuration  for green-colored responsive traffic.

max_probability.description: The weighted random early detection maximum probability  for green-colored responsive traffic.

max_threshold.description: The weighted random early detection threshold maximum  point for green-colored responsive traffic.

min_threshold.description: The weighted random early detection threshold starting  point for green-colored responsive traffic.

responsive_red.description: The weighted random early detection configuration  for red-colored responsive traffic.

max_probability.description: The weighted random early detection maximum probability  for red-colored responsive traffic.

max_threshold.description: The weighted random early detection threshold maximum  point for red-colored responsive traffic.

min_threshold.description: The weighted random early detection threshold starting  point for red-colored responsive traffic.

responsive_yellow.description: The weighted random early detection configuration  for yellow-colored responsive traffic.

max_probability.description: The weighted random early detection maximum probability  for yellow-colored responsive traffic.

max_threshold.description: The weighted random early detection threshold maximum  point for yellow-colored responsive traffic.

min_threshold.description: The weighted random early detection threshold starting  point for yellow-colored responsive traffic.

vsx_sync.description: Controls which attributes should be synchronized between VSX peers. 'all_attributes_and_dependents': the entire schedule profile, including its entries, should be synchronized.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
